observations.why: First-person plural with a decisive verb enacts a collective decision-move — the speaker positions the group as having chosen, performing authority through we-ness that overrides individual preference.
Proportionality framing — the switch is justified by quantified cost-benefit ratios, the hallmark of market-pricing relational logic.
Bolded heading format enacts a directive label — structuring the record as an authoritative summary of a decision, ranking this item as settled.
Quantified performance gain restated as a headline metric — proportionality framing carried into the summary record.
Setting a timeline is an authority-ranking move — allocating time as a ranked resource, committing the group to a deadline.
